about: The site's data catalog: every kind of data, where it comes from, its one home on the site, the branch or store that keeps it, the workflow that makes it, how often, and the pages that read it. scripts/data_catalog.py measures each home in the built site (files, size, when last made) at every deploy and writes data/catalog.json; the page #data draws it. A folder of the built site that no kind lists appears there as not catalogued, so a new data set cannot go unseen. homes: paths in the built site (a trailing / is a folder). remote: data the pages read from the repository instead of the site (raw.githubusercontent.com), with no size here. fresh: [file, key] when the default (built_at, finished, generated_at, generated, updated_at in the home's first JSON file) is not right.

overlaps.title: 13F positions are kept twice in the main branch
overlaps.what: The collector's cache (disclosures/docs/data/cache/holdings, 10,872 managers, 4.7 GB gzip) and the published quarters (shards/holdings, 87,000+ files, 4.9 GB+) hold the same positions: the shards are the cache re-cut into one file per manager and quarter for the pages.
overlaps.plan: Keep the cache as the one store and publish the quarters to a data branch force-pushed as one commit (like the other data sets), so the main branch stops carrying every rewrite of them.

overlaps.title: 13F holders per stock: the latest quarter and the long history
overlaps.what: disclosures/data/holders/<T>.json (every processed manager's latest position, built from the collector's cache) and holders-history (each quarter since 2013 from SEC's 13F data sets, largest 30 holders) answer the same question at two depths.
overlaps.plan: Complementary for now: the history file is the one for anything over time (the holders video); the latest file for this quarter's full list.

overlaps.title: Prices in four stores
overlaps.what: Weekly closes since 1990 (rotation-history), the collectors' daily closes (cache/prices), hourly ladders (ladder-history) and ETF prices with distributions (etf-history, px/): different steps and coverage, each read by its own views.
overlaps.plan: One price store with daily closes and distributions as the source, the weekly and hourly views cut from it.

overlaps.title: Company list and tickers
overlaps.what: data/index.json (companies with charts), SEC's ticker list (cache/prices/sec-tickers.json) and the CUSIP → ticker map (market/cusip-tickers.json) each name companies; the search index joins them.
overlaps.plan: data/index.json as the company master, with every other list keyed by its CIK.
